description: Changes: marks one booked stay that did not arrive a no-show; whatever the hotel's policy posts is shown in the preview and left for the desk (nothing is collected). Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Marks a booked stay due today or earlier as a no-show. First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes. Not for a stay booked on Expedia or Booking.com. Second step: after the preview, the call with confirm true sends a link to the person's own phone or e-mail; the change is made only when they open it and press Approve. Call again with the same values to learn whether it was made. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview

reason_code.description: The hotel's reason, when it has a list
